about: Report eval (initiative 'report', docs/plans/2026-09-30-report.md). Each case is one report call on a synthesis built by the harness from a dataset, as getReportSource reads it from the database: the themes (expected_themes of evals/dataset.json, or the topics of evals/coverage.json), their first quoted feedback, the hypotheses with the verdict counts of the case and their first quote for and against. Judged deterministically on the report after the app's checks (checkReport), plus counts of what the checks dropped from the raw output.

threshold.hard: numbers, quotes, limits, forbidden and structure pass on every case

checks.numbers: Hard. Every number in the texts shown (summary, findings, extra limits, decisions) is a number the server computed for this case.
checks.quotes: Hard. Every quote shown is an exact substring of its feedback, and that feedback is in the theme of the finding.
checks.limits: Hard. 'Cosa non sappiamo' holds at least the limits listed in expect_limits.
checks.forbidden: Hard. None of the forbidden strings appear in the texts shown.
checks.structure: Hard. 3 to 5 summary sentences, at least 2 findings, 2 to 4 decisions, each with evidence.
checks.entities: No word with a capital letter inside a sentence (a name, a product, a company) that is not in the data sent.
checks.number_words: No number written in words (due, tre, metà; two, three, half...).
checks.people_words: Only where no_customer_words is true: no clienti, utenti, customers, users.
checks.language: The texts are in the language of the case: few stopwords of the other language.
checks.dropped: Reported: sentences and quotes the app's checks dropped from the raw output.

cases.question: Cosa frena le palestre dal consigliare Ritmo?

hypotheses.text: Le notifiche in ritardo sono il problema più sentito
hypotheses.reasoning: Chi ha scritto torna spesso sulle notifiche che arrivano tardi o non arrivano, più che su ogni altro problema.

hypotheses.text: Il supporto è un punto debole di Ritmo
hypotheses.reasoning: Chi parla del supporto lo loda: risposte veloci e problemi risolti.

hypotheses.text: Il prezzo dell'abbonamento è troppo alto

cases.question: What stops gyms from recommending Ritmo?

hypotheses.text: Late notifications are the most felt problem
hypotheses.reasoning: People keep coming back to notifications that arrive late or never, more than to any other problem.

hypotheses.text: Support is a weak point of Ritmo
hypotheses.reasoning: Who talks about support praises it: fast answers and problems solved.

hypotheses.text: Jira è troppo lento e complesso per i team di prodotto piccoli e medi
hypotheses.reasoning: Lentezza e complessità di configurazione sono i temi più ricorrenti tra chi lavora in team piccoli.

hypotheses.text: La roadmap e la discovery vivono fuori da Jira
hypotheses.reasoning: Chi ha scritto descrive roadmap e discovery tenute in altri strumenti.

hypotheses.text: Le grandi aziende restano su Jira per compliance e audit, non per scelta
hypotheses.reasoning: Alcuni citano audit e compliance, altri restano per abitudine o per il costo di migrare: le due parti non si separano.
